verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical leaderboard crops. In each, the 'EVENT MANAGMENT' eyebrow is moved far left as tiny red text with no link to the headline it introduces. The upside-down owl is squeezed into the middle and pressed against the headline. Confetti stars sit behind and against the text, and the cupcake owl is cut off at the right edge. Candidate B's headline is slightly larger, so 'PARTIES' presses against the bottom edge with almost no margin. Candidate A keeps a little more breathing room, so it is marginally less cramped.
